senses.gloss: = h. צִיר II, hinge, pivot; socket; pin. Y. Ḥag. II, 77ᵈ bot. צ׳ דתרעא וכ׳ the pin of the gate of Gehenna was fastened to her ear; Y. Snh. VI, 23ᶜ bot. (corr. acc.).—Pl. צִירִין.
units: Targ. I Kings VI, 34 (h. text צלעים, קלעים) turning door-wings.

<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 26:17">Targ. Ex. XXVI, 17</cite> (Y. ed. Vien. <cite ref="R00335"><he>ציד׳</he></cite>, corr. acc.; h. text <he>ידות</he>); ib. 19 (ed. Vien. <cite ref="R00335"><he>ציד׳</he></cite>, corr. acc.); a. e.—

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 20:18">Targ. Y. Gen. XX, 18</cite> <he>ציריה בית ולדא</he>, <he>צירה ב׳ ו׳</he>, read: <he>צִירֵי דכ׳ ו׳</he> the hinges of the womb (v. <cite ref="R00450"><he>צִיר</he> II</cite>).—V. <cite ref="R00465"><he>צִירְתָּא</he></cite>.
